newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- An increase in share prices of leading companies and banks in 1996 pushed the National Bank of Abu Dhabi 27-share index of the unofficial stock market to record levels since 1988, a bank end of the year report said.
- U.S. exports to the UAE rose to $1.9 billion in the first three quarters of 1996 from $1.52 billion in the corresponding period of 1995.

- A ministry of planning report showed that the cost of living in Abu Dhabi emirate rose from November 1995 to November 1996. Food was up an avergage of five percent, accomodation up six percent and entertainment up 23 percent.

- The total value of non-oil trade between Dubai and the former Soviet Union states rose to 1.4 billion dirhams in 1995 from 23.9 million dirhams in 1991, an increase of 349.5 percent, a Dubai Chamber of Commerce and Industry report said.
